---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: "[ BUG ]"
labels: bug
assignees: cursssed

---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what's wrong (e.g. "module doesn't show up", "crash on launch", "shows wrong data")

**Environment (fill in all of these - most reports can't be diagnosed without them)**
 - Minecraft version: [e.g. 1.20.2]
 - Loader version: [e.g. NeoForge 20.2.93]  
 - REI - Mekanism Integration version: [e.g. 1.0.0 - check the jar filename]
 - Mekanism version: [e.g. 10.7.0.55]
 - REI version: [e.g. 26.2.820]

**Log**
Attach (don't paste inline) `logs/latest.log` from your instance, and `crash-reports/*.txt` if one was generated.

**Screenshots** (If it's a visual/HUD issue)
